audit_title: Phase 26 — Independent External Dataset Admission Audit

screening_methodology.normalized_filename: Strip leading numerical prefixes and case-insensitive match
screening_methodology.perceptual_hash: 64-bit difference hash (dhash) with Hamming distance threshold < 10 flagging near-duplicates
screening_methodology.session_provenance: Explicit session_id and source_video_id required from origin flight logs
screening_methodology.target_ontology: Strict matching to physical concentric circle landing pad geometry without fine-tuning
screening_methodology.negative_inventory: Verified target_count == 0 frames required to audit false alarm rates

candidate_audit_summary.name: KIOS 2022 Archive (Zenodo 7477560)
candidate_audit_summary.findings: Fatal contamination: all 422 real images in KIOS 2024 are byte-for-byte identical to files in KIOS 2022 Images.zip. Remainder of archive contains unverified mixed images.

candidate_audit_summary.name: KIOS 2024 Residual Real Frames (Zenodo 13682584)
candidate_audit_summary.findings: Severe temporal autocorrelation: all 422 frames stem from the same 2 flight sessions used for Phase 23 training and evaluation. Partitioning frames from the same video sequence violates independence.

candidate_audit_summary.name: IMAV 2025 Competition Benchmark Candidate
candidate_audit_summary.findings: Missing artifacts: competition imagery, capture manifests, session IDs, and verified negative frames have not been released. Blocked at the provenance gate.

candidate_audit_summary.name: TEKNOFEST Autonomous Drone Landing Dataset
candidate_audit_summary.findings: Target ontology conflict: visual targets are competition emblems ('UAP' text, crescent logo) rather than concentric circles. The frozen detector fails to recognize these patterns without retraining. Lacks session metadata.

candidate_audit_summary.name: HelipadCat / Rowan University Helipad Benchmark
candidate_audit_summary.findings: Perspective and scale mismatch: stationary full-scale airport/hospital helipads viewed from nadir satellite cameras. Incompatible with micro-UAV terminal landing pad detection.

candidate_audit_summary.name: Roboflow Universe Community Landing Datasets
candidate_audit_summary.findings: Semantic incompatibility: commercial 'H' folding pads and ArUco fiducials. Random frame-level splits with no session provenance or negative frame inventories.

candidate_audit_summary.name: Synthetic AirSim / Gazebo / Webots Suites
candidate_audit_summary.findings: Rendered computer graphics excluded by definition from real-image external generalization benchmarking.

audit_conclusion.rationale: All seven candidate sources failed admission under the preregistered zero-contamination and independence criteria. Candidates with matching concentric circle target semantics derive from the KIOS distribution and exhibit 100% byte or temporal session overlap. Candidates that are genuinely independent use different physical target markings that cannot be evaluated by the frozen detector without fine-tuning. Preserving scientific integrity requires declaring that external generalization cannot be evaluated until a dedicated physical capture flight campaign with replicated concentric circle landing pads is conducted.
audit_conclusion.scientific_integrity_statement: Admitting an overlapping dataset would produce an illusion of generalization; evaluating on an out-of-ontology dataset would measure semantic mismatch rather than robustness. The truthful outcome of Phase 26 candidate admission is that no existing public dataset qualifies.
